Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

If neither alternative can be offered for all six weeks, please tell me which dates are missing rather than booking only the dates that happen to be open.

There is one room detail that matters to us. Eli’s current practice keyboard has a narrow music rest, and the wide score book he uses can slide off it. At the open house Nadia had a full-size piano and a separate music stand in the room, which worked well. We are not asking the studio to provide a keyboard for use at home, and we are not asking for a special instrument. Could you confirm that the booked room has an acoustic piano and a separate music stand? If the room assigned to the lesson does not have both, please leave the lesson request unconfirmed and ask whether another suitable room is available before changing the time. If it does have both, there is no need to hold a different room just because of the music stand.

A few points about the booking and payment would help me plan. I saw the posted rate of $42 for a fifty-minute lesson, but I am not sure whether that rate applies to a six-lesson series or whether the studio charges a separate enrollment fee. Please tell me the total due for the six lessons and any required fee before charging the card. 3. If Nadia is ill or the studio has to cancel, please tell me how the studio handles that lesson and whether it can be made up. Please do not mark a studio cancellation as one of the six lessons until you explain the policy.
4. We can bring Eli’s current piano book and a notebook. He does not need a loaned instrument, and I have not asked for a book to be ordered.

Eli’s school band rehearsal is usually on Thursdays, which is why Thursday is not one of the alternatives, even though the school calendar has not yet confirmed every rehearsal date. On Tuesdays his grandmother can pick him up from school if I am delayed at work, but she cannot take him to the Saturday option.
